source.scope: Hashes identify the selected test/packaging sources and local binaries; this is not a claim that the entire uncommitted tree is immutable.

measurements.percentile_method: nearest rank; p95 of ten is their maximum

checks: dispatch actual checked-in hook command and args
real detached background learner without debug recorder
registered failure hook delivers make test

pass; adage-exec and adage-train companions staged
pass; includes bundled learner installation and real bootstrap with no adage on PATH, missing/corrupt companion refusal, original binary/fallback checks

prior_failures_resolved.failure: The debug plugin startup integration applied release latency budgets to a roughly 103 MiB debug executable.
prior_failures_resolved.resolution: Preserved all debug semantic assertions. Enforced the unchanged 1500/200 ms budgets in an optimized release artifact test instead.

prior_failures_resolved.failure: Recorder-dependent tests expected ADAGE_TEST_NO_SPAWN records from release binaries, where the instrumentation is intentionally absent.
prior_failures_resolved.resolution: Only instrumentation-dependent tests explicitly ignored in release; debug suite runs all cases. Added real-process release bootstrap coverage.

prior_failures_resolved.failure: Bundled executor was copied without its learner companion, so plugin-only delegation could lose background learning.
prior_failures_resolved.resolution: Verify and install both binaries beside each other; local plugin build stages both; real-bootstrap regression passes.

prior_failures_resolved.failure: Release archive staging accepted archives without a checksum despite claiming verification.
prior_failures_resolved.resolution: Missing checksums now fail closed before extraction; regression covers missing and incorrect checksums for both archives.

limitations: One local macOS arm64 host; not a substitute for native CI on the complete promised release matrix.
GitHub Actions billing/spending restriction remains an external validation blocker.
No live paid-agent run or GPU/cost saving estimate is established by these startup checks.
Windows automatic execution remains E0-only; Windows Claude Code plugin invocation is not verified by Unix checks.
The archive integrity test uses small fake binaries; it proves packaging rejection behavior, not execution of every native target.
No release tag, package publication, marketplace publication, or OS signing/notarization was performed.
The broader release-mode integration suite was not rerun in full; the measured release run selected the real startup gate.
